morphology.pattern_note: 基本形式无词缀；i 与 a 分属相邻音节，词尾 k 通常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。输入 Jawi 对应波纹义；同形异义的词源和 Jawi 不应自动合并。

senses.en_definition: A ripple or small wave on water.
senses.ms_definition: Ombak kecil atau gerakan membulat pada permukaan air.
senses.nuances: 核心义；常用重叠形式 riak-riak。前三义参见 [DBP：riak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=riak)。

senses.zh_definition: 空气的波动，尤指炎热时可见的热浪晃动。
senses.en_definition: An undulation of air, especially visible heat shimmer.
senses.ms_definition: Getaran atau gerakan beralun pada udara.
senses.nuances: 偏描写性；不能据此把所有热浪天气都称为 riak。

senses.zh_definition: 表情、神态；显露内心情绪的细微迹象。
senses.en_definition: An expression or outward sign of an inner feeling.
senses.ms_definition: Gerak-geri atau tanda yang memperlihatkan perasaan.
senses.nuances: 比喻义；并非固定表示傲慢。

senses.zh_definition: 痰；从呼吸道咳出的黏液。
senses.nuances: 独立同形词 riak II；现代马来西亚日常表达通常选 kahak。参见 [Kamus Dewan：riak II](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)。以下是此义的说明性搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 爱炫耀的；尤指为博取称赞而展示善行或宗教功修。
senses.en_definition: Ostentatious, especially in displaying good deeds to gain praise.
senses.ms_definition: Suka menunjuk-nunjukkan kebaikan atau ibadah untuk mendapat pujian.
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 将 riak III 标为指向 riyak 的旧形式；现代也可见 riak 作此义，严谨书写可用 riyak。不同于波纹义。参见 [Kamus Dewan：riak III](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf) 与 [DBP：riyak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=riyak)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Rakaman tersebut menunjukkan riak air yang terhasil apabila titisan hujan mengenai permukaan kolam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该影像展示了雨滴落在池塘水面时形成的涟漪。
dual_scenarios.en: The recording shows the ripples produced when raindrops strike the pond's surface.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tengok riak muka dia tadi, macam dah tahu je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Melihat riak wajahnya tadi, dia seolah-olah sudah mengetahuinya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 看他刚才那表情，好像早就知道了。
dual_scenarios.en: Judging by his expression earlier, he seemed to know already.
spoken_features: tengok 是常见口语用词，标准对应词为 melihat

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tengok riak muka dia tadi, macam dah tahu je.
messages.ms_standard: Melihat riak wajahnya tadi, dia seolah-olah sudah mengetahuinya.
messages.zh: 看他刚才那表情，好像早就知道了。
messages.en: Judging by his expression earlier, he seemed to know already.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Entah lah, aku tak nak teka. Tanya dia terus je.
messages.ms_standard: Saya tidak pasti dan tidak mahu membuat andaian. Tanya dia secara langsung sahaja.
messages.zh: 不知道啊，我不想乱猜，直接问他吧。
messages.en: I'm not sure, and I'd rather not guess. Just ask him.

etymology.historical_story: A small disturbance on water gives riak a vivid image for remembering its figurative sense: a slight facial movement can reveal an inward feeling. This is a teaching connection, not a proven chronology of semantic change. Dictionaries separately record riak meaning phlegm and an older form referring to ostentation; those homonyms should not be given an invented common origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=riak); [Kamus Dewan](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ri-aʔ，想象一滴水落下泛起“涟漪”：水面有波纹，脸上也会泛起情绪的微波。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: riak wajah 是中性的表情描述；说别人 riak，若指炫耀，则带道德批评意味，尤其涉及善行或宗教动机。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 根据搭配辨义：riak air 是波纹，riak wajah 是神情，sifat riak 是炫耀。不要仅凭一个表情就断言对方的意图。
